asset_manifests.name: Expedition Satellite Phone
asset_manifests.visual_identity: Heavy-duty, ruggedized handheld satellite communicator; matte charcoal grey body with reinforced orange rubber bumpers on the corners; features a thick, stowable flip-up antenna and a backlit physical keypad; the screen displays a 'Signal Strength: Strong' icon with a 2D map coordinate.
asset_manifests.notes: Essential for 'Overseas' expeditions where cellular service is non-existent. It is often seen clipped to Paleontologist 04's vest or charging via the gasoline generator in the Prep Tent.
